definitions.explanation: A place value in a number (ones, tens, hundreds, etc.).
A horizontal structural beam in construction, particularly in traditional Japanese buildings.

examples.japanese: この{計算|けいさん}は{桁|けた}が{違|ちが}っている。
examples.english: This calculation is off by an order of magnitude.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{年収|ねんしゅう}は{桁違|けたちが}いに{高|たか}い。
examples.english: His annual income is extraordinarily high (lit: different by digits).

examples.japanese: {八|はち}{桁|けた}の{数字|すうじ}を{入力|にゅうりょく}してください。

notes:
{桁|けた} has two main meanings related to structure: numerical place values and architectural beams.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {桁|けた}が{違|ちが}う (to be on a different level, orders of magnitude different)
- {桁違|けたちが}い (extraordinary, exceptional)
- {一桁|ひとけた} (single digit)
- {二桁|ふたけた} (double digits)
- {三桁|みけた} (three digits)

NUMBER VOCABULARY:
- {何桁|なんけた} (how many digits?)
- X{桁|けた}の{数字|すうじ} (an X-digit number)
